sources.note: Nothing for Okpe. The Okpe material is three untoned, unstressed texts (pp. 106-108, 'Okpe. Southern Nigeria. (3 texts.)', interpreted via Yoruba by Corporal Nimahan) plus 'Ok.' columns in the comparative dictionary. The only 'Accent and tone' section (pp. 141-142: 'The dynamic accent falls normally on the penultimate..') sits inside the EDO (Bini) grammar and does not refer to Okpe; the preface admits tones 'have been omitted in many cases'.
